scope: Source/configuration/documentation/public metadata audit. No author-module imports or scientific execution.

findings.finding: No public ARGformer branch/tag/release/source update since pin; sole release has zero attached assets; sole checkpoint issue reply is Resolved via email, without an asset URL.

No American simulation/inference recipe, query focal sampler/coordinate rule, Table1 PCA10 classifier/ancestry scorer, public checkpoint, or original data artifact recovered in all12 reachable snapshots.

Full leaf-to-root raw tuple deduplication precedes sorted node vocabulary and a seed-42 random 90/10 path split. Paths are specific to an ARG namespace, not an independent-subject or independent-ARG holdout.
Native input removes the extant leaf and retains up to 126 ancestors plus CLS/SEP in 128 tokens. Distinct full paths can have identical truncated inputs.
MLM delegates masking to the Hugging Face collator with 0.30 selected-token probability. The release does not force every selected token to MASK. Its generic masking test explicitly asserts 80/10/10.

The release objective uses normalized learned pooling and supervised in-batch contrastive loss at temperature 0.30. The YAML requests class weights, but train passes cfg.model while the weight loader seeks cfg.train_loader. The caught exception leaves uniform weights. No historical fix or alternative contrastive YAML was found.

The public contrastive CLI depends on absent yamls/defaults.yaml. Our wrapper bypasses it by loading the release YAML and calling unchanged train(cfg), without injecting model.train_loader. Several inherited tests reference missing configurations/modules and do not certify Table 1.

Author extraction supports trained head_norm and final-layer normalized pooling, without PCA. Multiple requested splits are randomly interleaved. Our separate single-split calls and raw-path sidecars preserve record identity.

Native retrieval returns normalized dot-product top-k indices/scores and optional supplied labels, with default k=1. It supplies no Table 1 ancestry voting or metric implementation, stable tie policy or self-exclusion.
The current README PCA2 example centers haplotype/individual means over all supplied rows. It is not reference-fitted 10-PC local-path classification.

All 96 local Java sources exactly match the fresh official v0.6.0 tag archive. Current master has the same 96 Java files, with only the AdmixMain version banner changed. No algorithm/options update was found.

Native default EM estimates admixture generations; gen=10 is an initial value. Our EM=true/gen=10 route therefore does not force 10 generations against a generation-12 simulation. Other thresholds are native defaults, with probs=true and nthreads=4 explicitly set.

The FLARE panel-probability GaussianMixture helper exists at both v0.6.0 and current master. It serves a separate unassigned-panel workflow, not ARGformer Table 1 PCA. Our native route uses known source panels without model or query ancestry inputs.

Supported claim is native author-release pipeline comparison on new shared biological reconstruction. Exact original data/Table1 reproduction and architecture-only attribution remain unsupported. No current pairwise-data defect established by this sourceaudit.

The repository retains different runtime recipes: requirements.txt uses Torch 2.3.0, Transformers 4.40.2 and Composer 0.22.x; pixi.toml uses Torch 2.4.0, Transformers 4.44.1 and Composer 0.24.1. This does not identify a unique original Table 1 environment.

limitations: No private/email-supplied assets, unreachable commits, forks or unadvertised external storage inspected.
No scientificdata arrays/model/checkpoint payloads opened, no authorcode imported/run, no numericaltests executed; runtime conformance is a separate evidentiary question.
FLARE full reachable commit history not downloaded; freshcurrent Java sourcecomparison and pinnedtag sourceverification cover relevant changes.
